Container.Name: Shrinkray
Container.Overview:
A simple video transcoding tool for Unraid. Select a folder, pick a preset, and shrink your media library with hardware-accelerated HEVC/AV1 encoding.
Presets include: Compress (HEVC/AV1), Downscale to 1080p/720p, SmartShrink (VMAF-guided auto quality), and Remux (lossless container change, e.g. MKV to MP4).
GPU Setup (Recommended): Without GPU passthrough, Shrinkray falls back to slower CPU encoding.
Intel/AMD: Add --device=/dev/dri to Extra Parameters.
NVIDIA: Install the Nvidia-Driver plugin (reboot after) and add --runtime=nvidia to Extra Parameters.
Temp Path (Optional): Map a fast cache drive to /temp and set temp_path: /temp in /config/shrinkray.yaml for faster transcoding.
Container.Requires: For hardware acceleration, GPU passthrough is required. See Overview for setup instructions.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Configuration directory. Stores shrinkray.yaml and the job database.

Config.Name: Media
Config.Description: Root of your media library to browse and transcode.

Config.Name: Temp
Config.Description: (Optional) Fast storage for temp files during transcoding. Set temp_path: /temp in shrinkray.yaml to use it.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID for file permissions (default 99 = nobody)

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID for file permissions (default 100 = users)

Config.Name: NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES
Config.Description: NVIDIA GPU(s) to expose. Use 'all' for single-GPU systems. For multi-GPU, set a specific GPU UUID from the Nvidia-Driver plugin page. Requires --runtime=nvidia in Extra Parameters.

Config.Name: NVIDIA_DRIVER_CAPABILITIES
Config.Description: NVIDIA driver features exposed to the container. 'all' enables compute, video, and graphics.
